data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: open5gs-slice-exporter
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - slice-exporter:8080

  - job_name: shared-amf
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - amf-metrics.share.svc.cluster.local:9090
        labels:
          nf_type: amf
          scope: shared

  - job_name: slice-1-smf
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - smf-metrics.slice-1.svc.cluster.local:9090
        labels:
          slice_id: slice-1
          slice_type: eMBB
          sst: "1"
          sd: "000001"
          nf_type: smf

  - job_name: slice-2-smf
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - smf-metrics.slice-2.svc.cluster.local:9090
        labels:
          slice_id: slice-2
          slice_type: URLLC
          sst: "2"
          sd: "000001"
          nf_type: smf

  - job_name: slice-3-smf
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - smf-metrics.slice-3.svc.cluster.local:9090
        labels:
          slice_id: slice-3
          slice_type: mMTC
          sst: "3"
          sd: "000001"
          nf_type: smf

  - job_name: ansa-session-orchestrator
    scrape_interval: 5s
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - 192.168.180.35:9105
